entities.name: Myojin of Cleansing Fire
entities.description: The Myojin kami of white magic on Kamigawa, embodying purification.

entities.name: Myojin of Blooming Dawn
entities.description: Another Myojin representing an aspect of white magic.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Daimyo with a shrine to the Myojin in his inner chambers.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Person taken the night the Myojin wept.

entities.name: Pearl-Ear
entities.description: Observed the Myojin crying sizzling tears.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which the Kami turned against mortals.

events.summary: Pearl-Ear sees the Myojin of Cleansing Fire weep sizzling tears the night Kyodai is taken.
events.quote: Pearl-Ear observed the Myojin crying actual tears that night

events.summary: During the Kami War the Myojin turns against mortals like the other Kami.
events.quote: During the Kami War , it turned against mortals like the rest of the Kami.

relations.note: Both represent an aspect of white magic; how they are related is not known.
relations.quote: It is not known how it is related to the Myojin of Blooming Dawn which also represents an aspect of white magic.
